zh.d:
数字员工完成工作后，可以把摘要和文件送到已连接的机器人会话；本次同时修复知识库导入、会话状态和历史列表性能问题。dream 引擎与内置模型依旧开箱即用，无需注册、无需粘贴 Key。

【新增】
· 【结果通知】数字员工支持选择机器人和接收会话，成功发送摘要、完整结果和工作区附件，失败发送原因；手动与定时运行均可使用
· 【图片排版】文字较多的图片可先用 HTML 排版再渲染为 PNG，支持图文布局与预览
· 【平台接入】添加模型平台时提供推荐平台入口及配置指引

【优化改进】
· 【会话历史】会话列表不再逐条扫描技能目录，减少加载等待；技能目录缓存避免反复解析未变化的文件
· 【数字员工】调度与通知统一设置，仅修改通知时保留原有调度；移除员工页过时的“从模板创建”入口，场景统一从场景页使用

【修复】
· 知识库在安装版中可正常导入文件，修复 PDF 运行依赖缺失，并覆盖五文件批量导入验证
· 知识库保存或替换原文件后搜索结果未及时更新，文档工具栏对齐及保存状态显示异常
· 会话重连后可能持续显示“处理中”，历史刷新请求堆积导致侧栏加载迟缓，以及附件面板过早加载
· 微信机器人会话上下文加密持久化，后端重启后无需再发消息才能继续接收结果通知
· 升级网络与压缩依赖，修复 13 条已知依赖漏洞

公司数字员工的结果通知复用成员自己已连接的机器人；企业连接状态与知识访问同步校验，减少显示已连接却无法访问的情况。

【新增】
· 【员工通知】成员可为公司员工选择自己的机器人接收会话，成功接收摘要和附件，失败接收原因，通知设置按用户隔离

【优化改进】
· 【团队同步】相同的团队技能同步与 MCP 同步请求使用缓存，减少切换团队和刷新时的重复文件扫描、数据库查询
· 【知识访问】企业页面与知识 MCP 使用一致的连接检查，员工结果通知继续复用本机机器人连接

【修复】
· 企业服务不可达时仍显示已连接，持续离线 15 分钟后未按设计切回个人模式
· 企业知识库的搜索更新、原件编辑和连接异常处理问题
· 消息事件拥塞后结束状态或文件变化丢失；连接恢复时重新同步会话状态

en.d:
Digital employees can deliver summaries and files to a connected bot conversation. This release also fixes knowledge imports, conversation status and history loading. The dream engine and built-in models still work out of the box, no sign-up and no API key needed.

【新增】
· Result notifications: choose a connected bot and recipient conversation for each employee. Successful manual and scheduled runs send a summary, full result and eligible workspace attachments; failed runs send the reason
· Image layout: text-heavy pictures can be laid out as HTML and rendered to PNG, with layout previews
· Platform setup: recommended providers and setup guidance are available when adding a model platform

【优化改进】
· History loading no longer scans the skill catalog for every conversation; unchanged skill files reuse parsed results
· Scheduling and notifications share one settings dialog, while notification-only edits preserve existing schedules. The obsolete employee template panel is removed in favor of the dedicated Scenes tab

【修复】
· Packaged knowledge imports include the required PDF runtime, with five-file batch import regression coverage
· Knowledge search refreshes after edits or original-file replacement; document toolbar alignment and saved-state display are corrected
· Reconnected conversations could remain busy, repeated list refreshes could exhaust requests, and attachment panels loaded too early
· WeChat conversation context is encrypted and persisted, allowing result notifications after a backend restart without another incoming message
· Network and archive dependencies are upgraded to resolve 13 known dependency vulnerabilities

Company employee notifications reuse each member's connected bots. Enterprise connection status and knowledge access are checked together.

【新增】
· Members choose their own recipient conversation for company employees, receiving summaries and attachments on success or the reason on failure. Preferences remain isolated by user

【优化改进】
· Identical team skill and MCP synchronization requests reuse cached results, reducing repeated scans and database queries during team switches and refreshes
· Enterprise pages and knowledge MCP use consistent connection checks; employee notifications continue to use local bot connections

【修复】
· An unreachable enterprise server could still appear connected; after 15 minutes offline the client now falls back to personal mode as designed
· Enterprise knowledge search refresh, original-file editing and connection-error handling
· Congested event delivery could lose completion or file-change events; reconnecting resynchronizes conversation state
